feature_definitions: All start/start-end tags emitted by HTMLParser, once each.
form start tags, including forms without action.
input start tags of any type.
a tags with an href attribute; empty and non-HTTP values included.
Link references resolvable to a valid HTTP(S) URL.
HTTP(S) links with registered domain different from page URL.
external_link_count / http_link_count; zero if denominator zero.
One reference per resource tag with its declared src/href attribute.
Resource references resolvable to a valid HTTP(S) URL.
HTTP(S) resources with different registered domain.
external_resource_count / http_resource_count; zero if denominator zero.
All script tags; does not imply executable JavaScript.
script tags with src, including empty/invalid/non-HTTP values.
script src references resolving to an external HTTP(S) domain.
iframe tags; content/srcdoc is not recursively parsed.
Union per tag of hidden attribute, input type=hidden, or explicit inline display:none / visibility:hidden declaration.
meta with stripped case-insensitive http-equiv=refresh, regardless of content validity.
form tags explicitly carrying action; includes empty values.
Explicit action references resolvable to HTTP(S).
Explicit HTTP(S) form actions with different registered domain.
external_form_action_count / http_form_action_count; zero if denominator zero.
